exercises.question: Which sentence expresses a prohibition?
options: No se permite fumar aquí. [Smoking is not allowed here.]
Hay que respetar las normas. [People have to respect the rules.]
Se puede entrar. [You can enter.]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que todos ___ las reglas.
exercises.english: It is important that everyone follows the rules.
It is necessary that we respect the rule.

sentences: El ruido molestaba a los vecinos. [The noise bothered the neighbours.]
Por eso el ayuntamiento prohibió el tráfico. [That is why the council banned traffic.]
Ahora la calle está más tranquila. [Now the street is quieter.]

exercises.question: Which sentence uses the subjunctive correctly?
options: Es fundamental que los vecinos hablen. [It is essential that the neighbours talk.]
Es fundamental que los vecinos hablan. [It is essential that the neighbours talk.]
Es fundamental los vecinos hablar. [It is essential the neighbours to talk.]

exercises.english: We have a responsibility towards our neighbours.

exercises.question: Which sentence defends a rule using rights?
options: Creo que la regla es necesaria porque protege los derechos de todos. [I think the rule is necessary because it protects everyone's rights.]
Esta regla existe en todos los edificios de la ciudad. [This rule exists in all the buildings of the city.]
Todos los ciudadanos tenemos derechos fundamentales. [All citizens have fundamental rights.]

exercises.sentence: Es fundamental que haya reglas claras.
options: It is essential that there be clear rules.
It is essential that there are no clear rules.
Clear rules are forbidden in this place.

exercises.sentence: Aunque la regla sea incómoda, debemos respetarla.
options: Although the rule may be inconvenient, we must respect it.
Because the rule is convenient, we can ignore it.
The rule is not allowed.

exercises.english: We have rights because we are citizens.

options: Es importante que escuche a la gente. [It is important that it listens to people.]
Es importante que escucha a la gente. [It is important that it listens to people.]
Es importante escucharé a la gente. [It is important I will listen to people.]
Porque protege a todos. [Because it protects everyone.]
Por eso protege a todos. [That is why it protects everyone.]
Aunque protege a todos. [Although it protects everyone.]
Creo que es necesaria porque protege a todos. [I think it is necessary because it protects everyone.]
Creo que es necesaria por eso protege a todos. [I think it is necessary that is why it protects everyone.]
Creo que es necesaria aunque protege a todos. [I think it is necessary although it protects everyone.]

exercises.question: Which statement connects rights and responsibilities?
options: Tenemos derechos, pero también la responsabilidad de respetar los derechos de nuestros vecinos. [We have rights, but also the responsibility to respect our neighbours' rights.]
Si tenemos derechos, no tenemos la responsabilidad de respetar las reglas. [If we have rights, we do not have the responsibility to respect the rules.]
Las responsabilidades de cada persona no tienen relación con las leyes. [Each person's responsibilities have no relation to the laws.]

template.prompt: Say that smoking is not allowed here because it protects the children, so we must respect the rule.
template.answer: No se permite fumar aquí porque protege a los niños; por eso debemos respetar la norma.

template.prompt: Write two sentences: you think the rule is necessary because it protects everyone's rights; although it may be inconvenient, we have the responsibility to respect it and consider its consequences.
template.answer: Creo que esta regla es necesaria porque protege los derechos de todos. Aunque sea incómoda, tenemos la responsabilidad de respetarla y considerar sus consecuencias.
